title: Eclipse Shadow Model (Cylindrical)
text: Calculate fraction of solar disk visible at inertial positions, 5 inputs, 3 outputs, {Ephemeris model} sets Ephemeris model; {Units} sets the position port units Metric, {Shadow model}, {Output index of shadow region}, {Time source}, {Start date/time (JD)} sets the initial start date and time for simulation, {Central body} sets the occulting celestial body for eclipse calculations, {Equatorial radius} sets the custom central body radius, {Include Moon} sets the option to include Moon, {Include Earth} sets the option to include Earth, {Limit ephemerides date range} sets the open to enable start and end of range of ephemeris, {Start date (JD)} sets the start date of ephemerides date range, {End date (JD)} sets the end date of ephemerides date range, {Action for out-of-range input} sets the out-of-range block behavior and {Enable zero-crossing detection}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: X icrf
ports.summary: Position of spacecraft 3-element vector | M -by-3 array

ports.name: ΔT JD
ports.summary: Elapsed Julian time with respect to T0 JD scalar

ports.name: Fraction
ports.summary: Fraction of visible Sun scalar | M -element vector

ports.name: Secondary Region
ports.summary: Secondary region scalar | M -element vector | integer

params.name: Units
params.values: Position port units Metric (m) (default) | Metric (km) | English (ft) | English (M)

params.name: Output index of shadow region
params.values: Output index of shadow region on (default) | off

params.name: Time source
params.values: Time source method Dialog (default) | Port (Julian date) | Port (T0 and elapsed Julian time)

params.name: Start date/time (JD)
params.values: Initial start date and time for simulation juliandate(2020, 1, 1) (default) | valid scalar Julian date

params.name: Central body
params.values: Occulting celestial body for eclipse calculations Earth (default) | Moon | Mercury | Venus | Mars | Jupiter | Saturn | Uranus | Neptune | Custom

params.name: Equatorial radius
params.values: Custom central body radius 3396200 (default) | double scalar

params.name: Include Moon
params.values: Option to include Moon on (default) | off

params.name: Include Earth
params.values: Option to include Earth on (default) | off

params.name: Ephemeris model
params.values: Ephemeris model DE405 (default) | DE421 | DE423 | DE430 | DE432t

params.name: Limit ephemerides date range
params.values: Open to enable start and end of range of ephemeris data on (default) | off

params.name: Start date (JD)
params.values: Start date of ephemerides date range juliandate(2020, 1, 1) (default) | Julian date

params.name: End date (JD)
params.values: End date of ephemerides date range juliandate(2050, 1, 1) (default) | Julian date

params.name: Action for out-of-range input
params.values: Out-of-range block behavior Error (default) | Warning | None
